ALGER, 10/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le Co: ALGIERS, 07/10/2026 (Algeria Tech) — The African Artificial Intelligence (AI) Council begins its operational phase on the occasion of the holding of the World Summit on the Information Society 2026 and the AI ​​Governance Summit. Algeria, represented by the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zouari, chairs this continental movement.
Adoption de la feuille de route stratégi: Adoption of the strategic roadmap for AI in Africa
Le Conseil africain de l'intelligence ar: The African Council on Artificial Intelligence (CAIA) organized, on the sidelines of the two international summits, its second official meeting with the active participation of the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zouari. During this meeting, members validated the road map and the action plan for the next two years, thus marking the effective start of the Council's activities. Six specialized commissions have been officially established to manage the implementation of the strategic axes defined by the continental AI strategy. These commissions will cover key areas such as regulation, technological innovation, human resources training, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and sector applications.
Par ailleurs, la réunion a permis d'écha: Furthermore, the meeting provided an opportunity to discuss the challenges common to African countries in terms of the integration of AI technologies, particularly in terms of digital sovereignty, access to data and intercontinental collaboration. Participants highlighted the importance of mobilizing the necessary investments to accelerate the deployment of AI solutions adapted to African realities, while ensuring an inclusive and ethical approach.
Pour l'Algérie, cette présidence du CAIA: For Algeria, this presidency of the CAIA represents a major opportunity to strengthen its positioning in the African technological landscape. The country, which already has a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem with players like Algérie Télécom, Mobilis SA and local startups, could take advantage of this dynamic to accelerate its transition to an economy driven by innovation. The establishment of specialized commissions will help structure national efforts and promote public-private partnerships in strategic sectors such as agriculture, health and education.
Sur le plan technologique, l'adoption de: On a technological level, the adoption of AI solutions could help optimize the management of public resources, improve the efficiency of administrative services and strengthen the competitiveness of Algerian companies. However, challenges persist, particularly in terms of training local skills, access to cloud infrastructures and securing data. The government will therefore need to accelerate ongoing reforms, such as the 2030 digital plan, to create a favorable environment for the emergence of a local AI industry.
Contexte du secteur TIC algérien: Context of the Algerian ICT sector
L'Algérie affiche une dynamique remarqua: Algeria displays remarkable dynamics in the information and communication technologies (ICT) sector, with a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% in 2025, according to the latest data from the Postal and Electronic Communications Regulatory Authority (ARPCE). The number of Internet subscribers stands at more than 30 million, a growing proportion of whom access broadband services via optical fiber and 4G. The 2030 digital plan, launched by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, aims to increase this coverage to 100% of the wilayas and to achieve an average speed of 100 Mbps by 2030.
Dans ce cadre, Algérie Télécom, opérateu: In this context, Algérie Télécom, historic operator, plays a central role by deploying the latest generation infrastructure and modernizing its network. The company has invested more than 50 billion Algerian dinars since 2020 to expand its fiber optic network, now covering 48 out of 58 wilayas. The operators Mobilis SA, Djezzy and Ooredoo are also contributing to this expansion by developing innovative offers and improving the quality of mobile services. The ARPCE, as a regulatory authority, ensures healthy competition and protects consumer rights while encouraging innovation.
Le ministre de la Poste et des Télécommu: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zouari, declared: “The Algerian presidency of the African AI Council is part of a strategic vision aimed at making our country a technological hub in Africa. We are committed to mobilizing all national and international stakeholders to achieve this ambition. » He also underlined the importance of collaboration with African partners to share good practices and pool resources.
Les prochaines étapes du Conseil africai: The African AI Council's next steps include finalizing the mandates of the six specialized commissions by the end of July 2026. An African summit dedicated to AI is planned for the first quarter of 2027, where heads of state and government of member countries are expected to adopt a joint declaration on the continent's strategic directions. For Algeria, this represents an opportunity to realize concrete projects, particularly in the areas of digital health, smart agriculture and electronic administration.
Par ailleurs, le ministère de la Poste e: Furthermore, the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications is currently finalizing a national AI plan, which will be integrated into the 2030 digital plan. This plan provides for the creation of 5 centers of excellence dedicated to research and development in AI, as well as the training of 10,000 specialists by 2028. The first pilot initiatives will be launched in the wilayas of Algiers, Oran and Constantine by the end of the year 2026.
